answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The mirror is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the copper. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the relic of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
